headline: Small S windswell, clean dawn but nothing worth the drive.
today: Short-period S swell around 1.5-2ft with an offshore NNW dawn, so it's clean early but weak and gutless. Fine if you're already out here, not worth the 2.5 hours. Log it on the morning low if you make the trip.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest day on paper at 2.4-3.2ft, but 17-20mph E cross to cross-on wind will chop it up. Windy and rough, not the clean Ditch you drive for.
Head-high-plus swell but 21-24mph NNE-NE hammering it all day. Big and blown — skip.
